text: I'm really scared, sorry. My stepdaughter Ellie is 8 and her temperature just read 39.4, I took it twice. She won't settle to sleep, keeps getting up, but otherwise she seems ok I think? I panicked when I saw red spots on her arms and legs but they're mosquito bites from being in the garden all day, they're raised and itchy and she's been scratching them all evening, her mum says she always gets eaten alive. I don't know if 39.4 is too high, should we be doing something now
